subject.title: [Feature]: Configurable managed-worktree cleanup limits (max count, max total size) with Settings UI

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose opt-in managed-worktree count and total-size limits in core configuration and the Worktrees Settings page?
rationale: The request adds user-facing configuration and eviction policy across core runtime and UI; source inspection establishes the gap but cannot decide whether these knobs meet the repository's configuration-surface bar.

options.title: Sponsor opt-in limits
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106224 as the canonical implementation, requiring protected-worktree invariants and real cleanup proof before merge.

options.title: Use fixed safeguards
options.body: Decline new knobs and instead add an opinionated disk-pressure warning or safe automatic bound without persistent configuration.

options.title: Retain current policy
options.body: Keep age-based and manual cleanup as the supported behavior and close this issue and its linked PR with rationale.

recommendation.title: Sponsor opt-in limits
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106224 as the canonical implementation, requiring protected-worktree invariants and real cleanup proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns the current proposal and linked cross-surface implementation, making them the best available routing candidate for this product choice.
